title: Mesh cleanup: hole fill, ceiling cap, floater removal
summary: First scene-graph stage: clean the reconstruction mesh into a watertight collision mesh suitable for traversal.

acceptance_tests.test: Given a corpus reconstruction, the service outputs a cleaned collision mesh with holes filled, the ceiling capped, and floaters removed.
Unit tests cover hole fill, cap, and floater removal on synthetic meshes.
requirements.txt pins exact versions; pip-audit clean.
